title: injury-status-final-2026-09-19
universal_lens: The sovereign primitives formalize the NFL injury-reporting ecosystem as a constrained state-transition system. Player availability is modeled via indicator functions over practice participation sequences, while roster adjustments and weather conditions act as exogenous perturbations to the underlying volume distribution matrix.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps the Friday practice logs (DNP/LP) to a Bayesian posterior probability of Sunday activation. The IR designation acts as a hard truncation of the feature space, forcing a conformal reallocation of expected targets across the remaining active roster vectors.
gse_mapping: GSE treats the slate as a Markov Decision Process where injuries induce immediate state transitions. Weather variables modulate the transition probabilities between run and pass states, dynamically altering the optimal DFS portfolio allocation for the given game script.

primitives.verbatim_quote: - The Chairshot NFL news roundup (2026-09-19) independently lists "Minnesota at Chicago with Wentz starting." **DFS implication:** Wentz at QB with a rain/wind game at Soldier Field — fade Vikings passing volume; Jones and the run game benefit.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: Wentz: Entity ID (QB); Rain/Wind: Environmental Vector (m/s, mm/hr); PassVol: Expected Passing Volume (dimensionless count)
primitives.assumptions: Adverse environmental vectors negatively correlate with passing efficiency and positively correlate with early-down rushing attempts.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails in dome stadiums or when extreme defensive mismatches force passing regardless of meteorological constraints.

layer2.mapping: Functions as an external forcing term in the GSE situational engine, shifting the equilibrium state from a pass-heavy to a run-heavy regime.
layer2.telemetry: Hourly meteorological forecasts overlaid against historical stadium-specific play-calling matrices.

These internal roster perturbations are then subjected to the environmental script modulator. The dualities emerge between hard exclusions (IR/OUT) and probabilistic uncertainties (Doubtful), requiring the GSE to maintain a dynamic, continuously updated state vector rather than relying on static projections.
